introduction: DC SNAP supplies food benefits through an EBT card to eligible households. Apply through District Direct or DHS paper application routes.
description: DC SNAP supplies food benefits through an EBT card to eligible households. Apply through District Direct or DHS paper application routes.

sections.who: DHS reviews income, expenses, household size and applicable status, student and work rules. Ask about current exemptions rather than assuming all adults have the same requirements.
sections.get: Monthly benefits are loaded onto EBT. Eligible groceries can be bought at participating shops and approved online retailers; order fees are separate.
sections.docs:
• Household and income information.
  • Address, identity and requested status evidence.
  • Housing, utility, care or medical expenses relevant to the calculation.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through DHS

    Use District Direct or the application methods listed on DHS Public Benefits.

  2. Respond to case follow-up

    Watch for interview and verification requests and retain copies of submitted evidence.

  3. Explain immediate food needs

    Ask DHS whether expedited assessment applies and seek local food help while awaiting a decision.
sections.after: Read recertification and mid-certification notices. Keep the EBT card and PIN secure.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DC SNAP overview; DHS application methods. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
